so that 目的 VS 结果
▪目的:从句多用may/might, can/could, should 等情态动词
▪结果:从句较少用情态动词,并非不可
▪目的(以便) VS 结果(所以)
▪She left early, so that she caught the train. 结果
▪She left early so that she could caught the train. 目的
▪She explained the story so that the students understood it. 结果
▪She explained the story so that the students might
understand it.目的
▪The hall was guarded by soldiers so that no outsiders might get in. 目的
▪The hall was crowed with people so that they couldn’t get in. 结果

grammar.title: 虚拟条件句
grammar.note: 先辨认假设与哪个时间的事实相反，再选择条件从句与主句的动词形式；过去事实的虚拟常用 had done / would have done。
grammar.example: If we weren’t living in the twenty-first century, people would think you were a witch.
